title: Compass vows to press on with FDA application despite new trial request
snippet: Citing the urgent unmet need for patients with advanced biliary tract cancer, Compass Therapeutics will continue to seek an approval path for its drug after the FDA recommended the biotech conduct a new clinical study.

title: Viking achieves 'maintenance trifecta' as GLP-1/GIP dual agonist exceeds expectations
snippet: Viking Therapeutics’ VK2735 met Truist’s “best-case scenario,” with robust weight loss that was largely maintained when patients transitioned to less frequent dosing. Viking’s stock popped more than 30% on Tuesday.

title: Vertex opens up larger kidney disease opportunity with mid-stage readout
snippet: While Vertex is laser-focused on an upcoming FDA decision for povetacicept in immunoglobulin A nephropathy, the APOL1 inhibitor inaxaplin has demonstrated potential “best-in-class” data in a different kidney disease.

title: Novo targets 10-fold jump in oral Wegovy manufacturing capacity by 2030
snippet: With sales of the oral GLP-1 medicine rising quickly, executives reassured investors that Novo has secured production capacity to support continued growth.

title: Lilly presents early data supporting GLP-1/GIP candidate's potential in depression, alcohol use disorder
snippet: With a trillion-dollar market cap and a wildly successful GLP-1 portfolio, Eli Lilly isn’t resting on its laurels. At the Psych Congress 2026, the company presented early-stage data that could support the potential of its next-gen GLP-1 and GIP receptor agonist to treat diseases far beyond obesity.

title: 2026 IPO blitz continues with 4 new biotech filings
snippet: With more than 25 companies debuting on the public markets, 2026 has recorded the highest number of biotech IPOs since 2021. Now, four companies—including Iambic Therapeutics and ADARx Pharmaceuticals—are looking to grow this total even further.

title: Novo’s workforce reduction climbs to 13,000 to fuel R&D work
snippet: Novo CEO Maziar Mike Doustdar disclosed an additional 4,000 staff departures, which a spokesperson told BioSpace are linked to attrition and other measures.
